FAQ

Questions we often hear

How long does a project take?

Modules are built in our workshop while site works happen in parallel, so installation takes only days once they arrive.

Can suites be customized?

Yes. Wood species, insulation, glazing and interiors are finalized with you.

Can I expand the suite later?

Absolutely. Modules can be added, stacked or relocated as your needs change.

Do you offer a free estimate?

Yes, a preliminary study and cost estimate are free, with a reply within 24 to 48 hours.
